defect: The review command treated decision_required=true as mechanical invalidity and made substantive resolution impossible even when mechanical_validation.passed=true.
repair: A passing substantive decision now requires mechanical_validation.passed=true. decision_required remains the signal that explicit review is necessary, while mechanically invalid outcomes remain impossible to pass.

verification.positive_regression: mechanically valid decision-required outcome accepts an explicit passing substantive review
verification.negative_regression: mechanically invalid outcome remains blocked from passing substantive review

compatibility_finding: The repair changes only the post-capture review transition. It does not alter the provider request, source payload, response schema, raw response, structured proposal, mechanical validation, cost, cache accounting, or substantive source comparison.
